checklist.title: Measure the rooms or walls you're asking about
checklist.detail: Wall length and height is enough — I'll calculate paint and prep from there. The on-site estimator uses the same numbers.

checklist.title: Take photos of each space
checklist.detail: One wide shot per wall you want painted, plus any problem areas you want fixed (nail pops, drywall patches, peeling trim).

checklist.title: Note any paint colours or brands you already have in mind
checklist.detail: Not sure yet? That's fine — I can bring colour samples. Just don't buy paint before we talk.

checklist.title: Think about access
checklist.detail: Is parking easy, is there an elevator or a walk-up, are there pets or kids to plan around? These affect scheduling more than anything else.

checklist.title: Decide what's in and out of scope
checklist.detail: One wall vs. whole house, trims and doors included or not — it's your call, and a clear scope keeps the quote accurate.

checklist.title: If you rent, get your landlord's okay sorted
checklist.detail: The form asks about this because painting a rental without approval causes real problems later.

checklist.title: Write down your questions
checklist.detail: Timelines, materials, how I work, anything you're unsure about — good questions now mean fewer surprises later.

closing_note: Nothing else is required before you hit send — the checklist is optional prep that makes the first conversation faster. I'll come back to you directly, with a real quote based on what you've sent (no automated promises here).
